title: Dead-letter record (one record of dlq.trust.movement)
description: A raw message that failed its contract, with the reason and enough lineage to find, fix and re-process it. The original bytes are kept verbatim in payload.

reason.description: Stable category, for the DLQ-rate-by-reason metric.

error_path.description: Where validation failed, e.g. body.actual_timestamp; absent when the payload is not JSON.

rule.description: The JSON Schema keyword that failed, e.g. pattern, required, enum.

received_at.description: From the source record's header (when the bridge received the frame).

payload.description: The source record's value, decoded as UTF-8 with replacement.

contract_version.description: Schema Registry version of the contract that rejected it.
